pages.en: “Settled, then. I'll come inside. Shirou, show me to the guest room. I had my eye on the one in the detached wing the last time I was here. Oh, and where would you like to sleep, Illya?”

pages.ja:
「別にどこでもいいけど、そこの女の近くはイヤよ」
「そうなの？ ならイリヤは和室ね」
もう愛称で呼ぶほど親密になったのか、遠坂とイリヤは気楽に言葉を交わしている。

pages.en:
“Anywhere is fine, as long as it isn't near that woman.”

“Really? Then you can have the tatami room.”

Have they already grown close enough for that kind of familiarity? Tohsaka and Illya talk with perfect ease.
